description: This file defines a React component called AppShell that creates a layout with a fixed sidebar and main content area. The sidebar includes navigation links with icons, branding, and informational text. The AppShell component determines the active navigation item based on the current URL pathname.

methods.name: Icon
methods.description: A functional component that renders SVG icons based on the provided name parameter ('dashboard', 'events', 'alerts', 'reports').
